title: Connect custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in and add Play Store (TWA) publish guide

requirements.text: Update the Internet Computer custom-domain configuration to use the full domain `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` so the app is accessible via that domain instead of the `icp0.io` canister subdomain (to mitigate “canister ID not resolved” / DNS issues on some ISPs).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` contains `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (and does not rely on only the bare label without the TLD)
The custom domain documentation reflects `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` consistently
After deployment, the app is reachable via `https://sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in`

requirements.text: Update `frontend/CUSTOM_DOMAIN_DEPLOYMENT.md` to provide clear, English, step-by-step instructions for connecting and verifying the custom domain `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` (including where the domain value is configured in the repo).
acceptanceCriteria: The document explicitly names `sciquiztn-knowledgebyte.in` as the target domain
The document points to the exact file path `frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains` as the domain configuration source
Instructions include a verification checklist (e.g., expected URL, basic smoke-test steps)

requirements.text: Add an English, step-by-step guide in the frontend documentation for publishing the existing web app to the Google Play Store using a Trusted Web Activity (Bubblewrap), tailored to the deployed URL and including required Play Console assets and checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: A new documentation file exists under `frontend/` (or `frontend/docs/` if present in the repo) describing how to generate an Android App Bundle (.aab) via Bubblewrap/TWA for this app
The guide includes: prerequisites, commands/steps to build the TWA, where to set the start URL, how to produce the `.aab`, and Play Console submission checklist
The guide lists the required store listing assets (icon, feature graphic, screenshots) and links to the generated filenames from `frontend/public/assets/generated/`

requirements.text: Add the required Play Store/TWA static images to `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and reference them from the Play Store (TWA) publishing guide.

quotes: If I want to publish this app in Play Store what should I do?

acceptanceCriteria: The generated image files exist at `frontend/public/assets/generated/` with the exact filenames specified in this build request
The Play Store/TWA guide references these exact filenames and their intended usage (without requiring any backend routes to serve them)

constraints: Frontend paths listed as immutable in SYSTEM_CONTEXT must not be edited (compose components instead of modifying those sources).
Keep the backend single-actor architecture; do not introduce additional backend services.
Use English for any user-facing text or documentation added/updated.
Do not route generated images through the backend; serve them as static assets from `frontend/public/assets/generated/`.
nonGoals: No new quiz gameplay features or UI redesign unrelated to the custom domain connection or Play Store packaging.
No third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity remains).
No native Android feature development beyond wrapping the existing web app via TWA.

required: Square app icon illustration: a clean, modern science quiz emblem with simple lab/atom motifs, high contrast, no text (playstore-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Wide feature graphic illustration: abstract science-themed banner with subtle icons (molecule, flask, lightning) and clean gradients, no text (playstore-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png)
Screenshot-style promo image: a realistic app UI mock of a quiz question screen on a generic phone frame, science-themed background accents, no store badges (playstore-screenshot-1.dim_1080x1920.png)
Screenshot-style promo image: a realistic app UI mock of results screen on a generic phone frame, celebratory science-themed accents, no text overlays (playstore-screenshot-2.dim_1080x1920.png)
